values.value: In Marketing Cloud, is there an agreed subscriber key and a modelled set of sendable data extensions — or would the audience model be designed from scratch as part of this migration?

[{"value":1,"label":"Nothing modelled. No agreed subscriber key, no sendable data extensions, no attribute sets."},{"value":2,"label":"Some sendable DEs exist for tactical sends, built ad hoc. No agreed subscriber key and no attribute-set design."},{"value":3,"label":"A subscriber key is agreed, sendable DEs and attribute sets are modelled, and Contact Builder is the audience source of truth."}]

docs/specs/tier-2/sfmc-target-adapter.md — T-4, "The adapter does NOT generate Data Extension schemas. The user models DEs themselves ... The adapter documents the requirements and relationships: this Journey needs a sendable entry DE keyed on SubscriberKey with these columns", and the division-of-labour table, "Data Extensions | Writes Markdown gap docs | Builds DEs in Contact Builder following the docs". capabilities/platforms/sfmc.yaml — entry_sources are api_event, data_extension, salesforce_data and audience_studio, every one of which presumes a subscriber model already decided. This is the single largest piece of work the accelerator explicitly does NOT do for you, which is why it is asked before it is discovered.
